stem: Reservoir EC remains steady while water volume falls and make-up water is added without nutrient analysis. What is the strongest concern?
choices: Stable EC may hide changing ion ratios, so water and nutrient mass balance should be evaluated
Stable EC proves solution composition is unchanged
Only pH can change in recirculation
Make-up water has no effect on chemistry
rationale: Bulk EC does not identify individual ions and can remain similar while nutrient composition changes.
